kernel.governing_law: The speaker addresses a community caught between two failures: submitting to inherited authority or fragmenting into private authorities — both of which betray the community's reason for existing, which is to be neither institution nor isolation.
kernel.mutated_relation: The conditions of address themselves become the subject: what must already be true for this rebuke to be utterable — the speaker's own implication in the authority they wield, the listener's prior consent to be rebuked, the gathering's dependency on the very grammar it contests.

running around on your lonesome -> the freedom that required the group to be visible against
setting yourselves up as tiny professors -> the authority that borrows the shape it disavows

claiming allegiance to this or that category of identity -> the self-naming that needs the community's ear to land
rejecting the authority of communal grammars altogether -> the refusal that is only legible inside the commune
rife with schism -> the splitting that proves the prior whole
unreceptive to feedback -> the closure that presupposes the open channel
carving out fiefdoms of personal glory -> the private territory cut from the common ground it requires
dealing in the coin that is the Academy's -> the currency that circulates only because you said you burned it

independent.recovered_law: TEXT B transforms every direct address and stated claim into a reflexive exposure of the hidden preconditions and performative contradictions underlying the speech act itself: the speaker no longer addresses an audience but instead reveals how the audience's prior complicity constructed the speaker's authority, and every named phenomenon (diaspora, grammar, schism) is replaced by the structural paradox that makes naming it possible.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: direct address/claims become reflexive examination of their own preconditions — speaker's authority revealed as constructed by audience complicity, and the utterance turns to expose the performative contradictions underlying itself.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion of TEXT B continues to recast each of TEXT A's accusations as self-undermining paradoxes (refusal legible only inside the commune, currency that circulates because you said you burned it), maintaining the changed relation throughout.
